sourceNote: Immutable metadata for the single model this app ships. Observed from Hugging Face's primary model API at the pinned revision; only the configuration, tokenizer configuration, template, card, and shard index were downloaded and hashed locally. Weight and tokenizer.json digests come from LFS metadata. Full-weight inference evidence is recorded separately.

models.name: Ternary Bonsai (8B)
models.provenance: Official Prism ML Ternary Bonsai checkpoint using MLX 2-bit packing for ternary weights. Source: https://huggingface.co/prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-8B-mlx-2bit/blob/9260b24298e4211e804663e9f519962cf59f34be/README.md License: https://huggingface.co/prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-8B-mlx-2bit/blob/9260b24298e4211e804663e9f519962cf59f34be/LICENSE
models.compatibilityNote: Ternary {-1,0,+1} weights packed at 2 bits with group size 128, over a Qwen3 backbone; 36 layers, text only. Stock MLX supports 2-bit affine quantization, unlike Prism's 1-bit line, which needs custom kernels the pinned runtime does not have. This exact app/device combination still requires a generation test.
